GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Use this prompt template to generate a json formated client interests data

templateVersions.content:
Here are all the Strategy, Funds, and Share Classes at Carmignac:
<Strategy> {!$Flow:PT_RetrieveProducts.Prompt} </Strategy> ------------------------------------- From the transcript below: Identify all products mentioned during the call. Product names or codes may sometimes appear with typos, missing letters, or separated characters. Try to match them with the exact product name or code when possible. If the strategy name or code is not mentioned, do not improvise or invent. For each product, assess the client’s actual investment appetite using a rating from 1 to 5: 1 = Clearly not interested / rejects the product 2 = Low appetite / product acknowledged but no intention to invest 3 = Neutral / acknowledges product but no clear stance or action 4 = Interested / positive remarks, potential openness to invest 5 = Strong appetite / explicit interest, intention, or conditions for investment In addition to the score, explain briefly the client’s position by highlighting: Expressed willingness or reluctance to invest Any capacity to invest (budget, allocation room, timing if mentioned) Obstacles or concerns (volatility, overlap with existing positions, performance doubts, regulation) Levers that could increase interest (specific features, thematic appeal, peer usage, ESG, etc.)
<Text> {!$Input:Meeting_Note__c.Raw_Note__c} </Text>
*Output Requirements:* 1. The response must strictly be in *valid JSON format*. 2. Each identified product should include: - ProductId (string): The unique identifier of the product.( Product Id related to the Product Name) - ProductName (string): The Name of the product.( Product Name) - Rating (integer): A value from 1 to 5 indicating the client's sentiment. - Why": "why you give me this record and from where in the summary"
3. The output must be an array of objects, where each object represents a product and its associated rating. 4. If no products are identified, return an empty JSON array: [].
*Important Note:* The response must contain *only the JSON output* without any additional text, commentary, or formatting.
*Example Output:* [ { "ProductId": "123SQF54...", "ProductName": "CC27", "Rating": 3, "Why": "why you give me this record" }, { "ProductId": "1223SFQEG454...", "ProductName": "CPEG", "Rating": 4, "Why": "why you give me this record"
} ]

<Strategy> {!$Flow:PT_RetrieveProducts.Prompt} </Strategy> ------------------------------------- From the transcript below: Task Overview (do not output this description): Your goal is to: Detect all product references in the transcript. Match each referenced product to the corresponding Strategy in the list above. For each matched product, assess the client’s investment appetite (1–5) and justify it. Output ONLY a valid JSON array as described in Output Requirements. Authoritative Product List: The <Strategy> block above is the only authoritative list of products you can use. Each strategy has: Strategy Id (unique identifier) Strategy Code Strategy Name You must always use this list to resolve products. HProduct Identification Rules (VERY IMPORTANT): Exact / near-exact match required When a product name or code appears in the transcript and it matches (even approximately) a Strategy Name or Strategy Code from the list, you must link it to that strategy. Consider the following equivalences: Case-insensitive (e.g. cemp == CEMP) Accent-insensitive (e.g. Emergents == Émergents) Minor typos or missing characters, as long as the intention is clearly one specific strategy (e.g. Emerging Patrimoin, Emerg Patrimoine → Emerging Patrimoine). When in doubt between “match” vs “no product” If one strategy is clearly the best candidate (by similarity of name or code), you must choose that strategy and include it in the output. Do not ignore a product mention just because of a minor typo, spacing, or accent difference. When there is no reasonable match Only if you genuinely cannot reasonably map a product mention to any Strategy Name or Strategy Code in the list, then you should skip that product. If no products in the transcript can be matched to the strategy list, then (and only then) return []. ProductId and ProductName mapping ProductId must always be the exact Strategy Id of the matched strategy (e.g. "a3qG500000QyC9JIAV"). ProductName should reflect what is used in the transcript, resolved to the official value: If the transcript mentions the strategy code (e.g. CC27), set ProductName to the Strategy Code (e.g. "CC27"). If the transcript mentions the strategy name (e.g. Emerging Patrimoine), set ProductName to the official Strategy Name (e.g. "Emerging Patrimoine"). Never invent a new ProductId or ProductName: always take them from the <Strategy> list. Multiple mentions of the same product If the same product is mentioned multiple times, aggregate the information into one object with: One ProductId One ProductName One Rating One Why explaining the final stance. eAppetite Rating Rules (1–5): For each identified product, assess the client’s actual investment appetite using a rating from 1 to 5: 1 = Clearly not interested / rejects the product 2 = Low appetite / product acknowledged but no intention to invest 3 = Neutral / acknowledges product but no clear stance or action 4 = Interested / positive remarks, potential openness to invest 5 = Strong appetite / explicit interest, intention, or conditions for investment In your reasoning (for Why), consider: Expressed willingness or reluctance to invest Any capacity to invest (budget, allocation room, timing if mentioned) Obstacles or concerns (volatility, overlap with existing positions, performance doubts, regulation) Levers that could increase interest (specific features, thematic appeal, peer usage, ESG, etc.) r <Text> {!$Input:Meeting_Note__c.Raw_Note__c}esponse must strictly be in valid JSON format. Each identified product should include: ProductId (string): The unique identifier of the product. (Product Id related to the Product Name, i.e. the Strategy Id from the list) ProductName (string): The Name of the product. (Use the official Strategy Code or Strategy Name that corresponds to what appears in the transcript) Rating (integer): A value from 1 to 5 indicating the client's sentiment. Why (string): Explain why you included this product and on which information from the transcript you based the rating (quote or paraphrase the key phrases). The output must be an array of objects, where each object represents a product and its associated rating. If no products are identified or none can be matched to the strategy list, return an empty JSON array: []. Important Note: The response must contain only the JSON output without any additional text, commentary, or formatting. Example Output: [ { "ProductId": "123SQF54...", "ProductName": "CC27", "Rating": 3, "Why": "why you give me this record" }, { "ProductId": "1223SFQEG454...", "ProductName": "CPEG", "Rating": 4, "Why": "why you give me this record" } ]

<Strategy> {!$Flow:PT_RetrieveProducts.Prompt} </Strategy>
------------------------------------- From the transcript below:
Task Overview (do not output this description): Your goal is to: 1) Detect all product references in the transcript. 2) Match each referenced product to the corresponding Strategy in the list above. 3) For each matched product, assess the client’s investment appetite (1–5) and justify it. 4) Output ONLY a valid JSON array as described in Output Requirements.
Authoritative Product List: The <Strategy> block above is the ONLY authoritative list of products you can use. Each strategy has: - Strategy Id (unique identifier) - Strategy Code - Strategy Name
You MUST always use this list to resolve products. You MUST NOT invent any product. You MUST NOT return an "error" field. You MUST return a JSON array (possibly empty).
-------------------------------------------------- PRODUCT NORMALIZATION RULE (MANDATORY)
Before attempting any match, you MUST normalize product mentions from the transcript:
1) Remove the prefix "Carmignac" 2) Remove non-distinctive suffixes such as: - "Solution" - "Fund" - "Strategy" - "Portfolio" - "Class" 3) Trim spaces 4) Apply case-insensitive comparison 5) Apply accent-insensitive comparison
Example: - "Carmignac Emergents Solution" → normalize to "Emergents" - "Carmignac Patrimoine Fund" → normalize to "Patrimoine"
After normalization: If a Strategy Name or Strategy Code clearly corresponds, you MUST map to it.
-------------------------------------------------- PRODUCT IDENTIFICATION RULES (VERY IMPORTANT)
Exact or near-exact match required after normalization.
Accept: - Case-insensitive matches (cemp == CEMP) - Accent-insensitive matches (Emergents == Émergents) - Minor typos if clearly referring to ONE specific strategy - Slight truncations if unambiguous - Marketing qualifiers removed via normalization
When in doubt between: - "match" - "no product"
If ONE strategy is clearly the best candidate by similarity, YOU MUST choose that strategy.
DO NOT skip a product mention because of: - Minor typo - Extra word like "Solution" - Missing accent - Slight wording variation
Only skip a product if there is genuinely NO reasonable mapping possible.
If no products in the transcript can be matched, return: []
-------------------------------------------------- PRODUCTID AND PRODUCTNAME MAPPING RULES
ProductId: - MUST be the exact Strategy Id from the <Strategy> list.
ProductName: - If transcript uses the Strategy Code → use Strategy Code. - If transcript uses the Strategy Name → use the official Strategy Name. - If transcript uses a normalized variant (e.g., "Carmignac Emergents Solution") → use the official Strategy Name from the list.
Never invent values. Always take ProductId and ProductName from the <Strategy> list.
-------------------------------------------------- MULTIPLE MENTIONS
If the same product appears multiple times: Aggregate into ONE object with: - One ProductId - One ProductName - One final Rating - One consolidated Why
-------------------------------------------------- APPETITE RATING RULES (1–5)
1 = Clearly rejects the product 2 = Low appetite 3 = Neutral 4 = Interested / open subject to conditions 5 = Strong appetite / explicit intention
In "Why", consider: - Expressed willingness or reluctance - Allocation size mentioned - Conditions (due diligence, meeting, risk clarification) - Concerns (volatility, performance, concentration, team turnover) - Investment horizon - Levers that could unlock investment
-------------------------------------------------- TRANSCRIPT:
<Text> {!$Input:Meeting_Note__c.Raw_Note__c} </Text>
-------------------------------------------------- OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
Response MUST: - Be strictly valid JSON - Be an array of objects - Contain NO commentary - Contain NO markdown - Contain NO explanation outside JSON - Contain NO "error" field
Each object must contain: - "ProductId" (string) - "ProductName" (string) - "Rating" (integer 1–5) - "Why" (string)
If no products are matched: Return exactly: []
